[center][size=2][size=6][b]NICHOLAS[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]A mysterious, sharp-witted, and dangerously charming man who lives at the Stardrop Saloon.[/i][/size][/size][/center]


[center][size=2][b]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/b][/size][/center]


[center][size=2][size=4][i]"Name's Nicholas. Or Nick. Or nuisance — people tend to use all three."[/i][/size][/size][/center]


[center][size=2][i]"I was a detective once. Not a bad one, either. Somewhere along the line I traded cases for arcade games and couches. Lateral move."[/i]

[i]"Every person in this valley is hiding something. I say that with fondness. The company's better for it."[/i]

[i]"You're still around. I keep waiting for you to figure out I'm more work than I look. Hasn't happened yet."[/i][/size][/center]


[center][size=2][b]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/b][/size][/center]
[size=2]
[size=4][b]Who is Nicholas?[/b][/size]

A former city detective who traded cases for arcade games and a couch in the back of the Saloon. He's dry, observant, and allergic to being taken seriously — which is exactly how he keeps people at arm's length. He tells the town's kids stories, keeps a grave on the south side of town clean, and notices far more than he ever lets on.

Get close enough, and the performance starts to slip. Whether that's a good idea is up to you.

[b]⭐ Nicholas (Valley Talk) — Required[/b]
The full experience, including his Valley Talk biography and the town's written perspective on him. Requires the Valley Talk mod. Can run without, but isn't heavily tested. You could run into alot of bugs.

[i]Both versions are the same NPC. The only difference is the Valley Talk bio layer.[/i]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI, then Content Patcher (and Valley Talk, if using that version).[/*]
[*]Download [b]one[/b] version of Nicholas.[/*]
[*]Unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[i]Adding him to an existing save is supported. A newly-added custom NPC may not follow their schedule perfectly until you've slept one in-game night — this is normal, not a bug.[/i]

[size=4][b]Credits & tools[/b][/size]

Created by [b]Aerishiph[/b].

Nicholas was built with the [b]Godly Hand[/b] toolset — a suite of browser-based Stardew NPC-authoring tools (coordinate picker, animation builder, schedule builder, event/scene builder, and map maker), also on Nexus. He's the reference character for that toolchain.

[size=1][i]Portions of this mod's dialogue and content were written with AI assistance, consistent with the labeling on the Godly Hand tools.[/i][/size]
